reader.notes: Edition-agnostic check on the sequential WRITE arm; the relative/indexed arm refuses any END-OF-PAGE phrase outright (COBOL1720), matching the 1985 relative/indexed WRITE formats, which have none. The page-overflow semantics shown by eop2 belong to the general rules and were not judged here.
